$description: Piano-bank loader index. Single-bucket libraries (edmSynthsPluckedLibrary, edmSynthsStabsLibrary) carry one fixed bucket; the multi-bucket `library` entry holds the legacy EZKeys patterns.json (7 genre buckets — ballad/edm/latin/brightPop/organicVibes/rock/urban; schlager + freestyle absent in the legacy data). docs/56c follow-on adds `library` + `altLibrary` to unlock per-genre keys + the legacy keyboardMonophonic*/keyboardPolyphonic synth styles.
